1950, October 7
SAINT FELIX FRIARY: HUNTINGTON INDIANA FEAST OF THE HOLY ROSARY. PEACE TO MEN OF GOOD WILL GLORY TO GOD 1950 HOLY YEAR
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
1950, October 7
Rev. Michael Z. Cefai Detroit, Michigan
God Bless you Father Cefai:
You and yours this beautiful feast and holy season. I do hope that you keep well; glad of course that your dear Parents and the others seem to hold out as years ago when I use to helpout at Saint Paul's. How imperceptibly time does fly! I certainly wish you success with your plans relative to taking-over that long-since dwarffed and recently orphaned episcopelian church of St. Peter. May the good God bless at once your confidence in the Committee in charge and their unbiased and -- in the face of present internat- ional atheism / -- reasonable judgement and prudent generosity.
In the face of international atheism? Yes. And this should be stressed in dealing with any and every such committee. If the members thereof are able to think for themselves, as surely their honorable responsabilities presupose they are, at least in this instance, then they ought / realize that, whereas; the faith of perhaps the great majority of men these days having become weak- ened, hope and charity, its necessary accompaniments have likewise waned. In consequence, religion, the great science of faith, hope and charity, -- the science of our happy dependence on God and our neighbor is refused recognition even by "educators", God is being ousted from our systems of education and, as a just judgement from Heaven on humanity's apathy atheism -- "the climax of intellectual insanity and of moral depravity -- is marshaling its diabolical forces, ready at the first opportunity "to take over" in place of God and religion. We need only to look across into red, communistic Russia to see some of the temporal . . s.
(unfinished draft)
